card.text: M18 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,501 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_6613: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 1500.72440549 pc (16th to 84th percentile 1496 to 1506)

sources.quote: Messier 18 or M18, also designated NGC 6613 and sometimes known as the Black Swan Cluster, is an open cluster of stars in the constellation Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M18 is drawn as 156 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
